typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblGMIMARGINSUMMARYMNYF1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MFIRM as string,
		MOFFIC as string,
		MACCT as string,
		MATYPE as string,
		MCURAT as string,
		MME as double,
		MSNAME as string,
		MCVTFB as double,
		MCURFM as string,
		MLVTM4 as double,
		MFIRMCONV as string,
		IMPORT_DATE as timestamp,
		MREL1A as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		MNA1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MarginSummary
MarginSummary split(MACCT == 'SCL100', disjoint: true) ~> MACCTRemoveSCL100@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
MarginSummary aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
MACCTRemoveSCL100@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		MOFFIC as string,
		MME as double,
		MCURFM as string,
		MFIRMCONV as string,
		MSNAME as string,
		MCVTFB as double,
		MATYPE as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MFIRM as string,
		MNA1 as string,
		MLVTM4 as double,
		Import_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MACCT as string,
		MCURAT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 5000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MOFFIC,
		MME,
		MCURFM,
		MFIRMCONV,
		MSNAME,
		MCVTFB,
		MATYPE,
		effDate = EFFDATE,
		MFIRM,
		MNA1,
		MLVTM4,
		Import_date = IMPORT_DATE,
		MACCT,
		MCURAT),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblGMIMARGINSUMMARYMNYF1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblGMIMARGINSUMMARYMNYF1
